    <h2>{`General Tips & Best Practices`}</h2>
    <h3>{`XML Tag Order`}</h3>
    <p>{`The order of XML tags is important. Although XML is a markup language, the MAF build process considers the declaration order throughout the file.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Best Practice:`}</strong>{` Declare datasources before using them in lookups or other components.`}</p>
    <h3>{`Logging`}</h3>
    <p>{`Use consistent logging to track progress during customization. Create a tag prefix to identify all code paths.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`AppCustomizations.js:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`// Add at the first line of the file
const TAG = 'CustomFeature';

// Use throughout your code
this.app.log.d(TAG, 'Processing started');
this.app.log.e(TAG, 'Error occurred', error);
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Server Logs:`}</strong></p>
    <p>{`Access server logs from your Manage (MAS) instance using this URL format:`}</p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{}}>{`https://(mas-manage-host)/maximo/oslc/service/logging?action=wsmethod:streamLog
`}</code></pre>

    /**
     * Called when application is initialized

     */

}

export default AppCustomizations;
`}</code></pre>
